design.name: Iron Covenant
design.identity: Yuma sworn defender who makes discipline a shared shield.
features: Choose bulwark or sentinel. As a Bonus Action spend one Channel Divinity use to empower one Shield you hold for one minute. Bulwark adds +1 Guard while holding it; sentinel allows you to use a Reaction to impose disadvantage on one attack against an ally within 5 feet. The effect ends if you release the Shield.
While your Aura of Protection is active, allies in it have advantage on saves against forced movement and against being knocked Prone. You must be conscious.
As a Reaction when an ally in your aura takes damage, spend one Covenant use to take half that damage instead. This transferred damage cannot be reduced; the ally takes the remainder.

Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action for one minute, gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing and prevent enemies from moving you against your will. Allies in your aura gain temporary Health equal to your Spirit modifier at the start of each of their turns. Restore the use with a level 5 spell slot.

features.completionRules: Sentinel requires seeing the attacker and declaration before the attack roll. Take the Burden splits post-mitigation damage: owner takes floor(damage/2), ally takes the remainder. Owner's portion cannot be reduced or transferred recursively. Standard temporary Health is max(1, Spirit modifier). Restore its spent counter as a Bonus Action with exactly one level-five slot.
